paragraphs.text: He called upon the Name of God, desiring him to prosper the people, and give good success to their beginnings.
paragraphs.label: a
paragraphs.anchor: blessed the people in the name

paragraphs.text: That is, God's benefits to his people.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: David gave them this Psalm to praise the Lord, signifying that in all our enterprises the Name of God should be praised and called upon.
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: delivered first this psalm to thank

paragraphs.text: Of which this is the chiefest, that he has chosen himself a Church to call upon his name.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Who of his wonderful providence has chosen a few of the stock of Abraham to be his children.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: In overcoming Pharaoh, which judgments were declared by God's mouth to Moses.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: Meaning by this that the promise of adoption only belongs to the Church.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: Meaning, from the time that Abraham entered, to the time that Jacob went into Egypt for famine.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: My elect and those whom I have sanctified.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: To whom God declared his word and they declared it to their posterity.
paragraphs.label: l

paragraphs.text: His strong faith appears in this, though all the world would follow idols, yet he would cleave to the living God.
paragraphs.label: m

paragraphs.text: Humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God.
paragraphs.label: n

paragraphs.text: He exhorts the dumb creatures to rejoice with him in considering the greatness of the grace of God.
paragraphs.label: o

paragraphs.text: To restore all things to their estate.
paragraphs.label: p

paragraphs.text: He esteems this to be the chiefest happiness of man.
paragraphs.label: q

paragraphs.text: He wills all the people both in heart and mouth to consent to those praises.
paragraphs.label: r

paragraphs.text: With Zadok and the rest of the priests.
paragraphs.label: s

paragraphs.text: Declaring that after our duty to God we are chiefly bound to our own house, for which as for all other things we should pray to God, and instruct our families to praise his Name.
